articles.title: Trump Touts Baby Bonds in Georgia, But Delays and Criticism Cloud the Rollout
articles.summary: President Trump promoted his $1,000 baby bond program at a Georgia high school. While 6.5 million have signed up, some parents report weeks-long waits for the seed money. Critics say the program ignores immediate child poverty needs.

articles.title: From Algae to Arrests: How the Reflecting Pool Became D.C.'s Must-Watch Drama
articles.summary: What started as a quick $2 million resurfacing of the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool has spiraled into a $14 million saga involving green algae, peeling paint, felony charges, and a 5,000% spike in Google searches.

articles.title: England Caps Bus Fares at £2 to Ease Cost-of-Living Squeeze, But Rural Gaps Remain
articles.summary: The UK government will cap most English bus fares at £2 from January, a £500 million bid to help households. Critics say the move ignores rural service cuts, and funding questions linger.
